observation.barge_in_logic: cancel_for_barge_in() derives cancelled_turns only from nonterminal cancellable output packets. Active tool refs are cancelled only when their owner_turn is in that output-derived cancelled_turns set.
observation.tool_only_case: A turn can emit TOOL_USE before any output packet exists. If user barge-in then occurs while that tool is still active, candidates may be empty, cancelled_turns stays empty, and the tool_ref remains in _active_tools.
observation.late_result_path: emit_system_event(... TOOL_RESULT ...) accepts a tool result whenever _active_tools[tool_ref] still equals the originating turn_id. Therefore the late completion from the interrupted tool-only turn can still be admitted after barge-in.
observation.existing_test_gap: test_cancelled_turn_rejects_late_tool_result covers only a turn that already has a started output, so cancelled_turns contains that turn and does not exercise the tool-only ownership case.

risk: Barge-in/cancellation is intended to revoke stale turn ownership, but the current implementation couples tool cancellation to presence of an output packet. A tool-running pre-output turn can survive user interruption and later inject a result into the session under stale ownership.

setup: Emit TOOL_USE for turn-old with tool_ref tool:slow and no output packet for turn-old.
